COMPOSITION

This means one generic slot gets reused; I'll route the two offers into the features slot (matching its 3-parallel-item structure well since it has two clear sub-offers plus intro), keep stats unused since there's no numeric data, and use content-image and banner/testimonial/cta as anchors for the closing sections, preserving the dark→neutral→light→dark→light→dark flow as closely as content allows.
